Resolves #21726

🌿 A day can no longer lose its name to the left edge while its bars are still in view.

Minor ticks now render their text in the `neo-timeline-tick-label` span that major ticks use, and #20890's sticky rule covers minor ticks of unit day, week or month. Hours stay unpinned. Three unit assertions that read a minor tick's `text` now read its label.

Evidence: L3 (headless Chromium e2e on `examples/gantt/zoom`; the pin is CSS `position: sticky`) → L3 required (AC-1 and AC-2 are rendered positions). Residual: none.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 a scrolled-out day keeps its name at the visible left edge, red on `dev`, green at head | CI: `e2e/gantt/ZoomNL.spec.mjs` › "a day whose start is scrolled out keeps its name in the minor row, an hour does not (#21726)"; red on `dev` in Test Evidence |
| AC-2 an hour is not pinned | CI: the same test's Day-level arm |
| AC-3 every minor tick renders a label span, and the timeline unit specs pass | CI: `unit/timeline/TimeAxisHeader.spec.mjs` asserts the span; `unit/timeline/TimeAxisZone.spec.mjs` |
| AC-4 no change to major ticks or to the hover of #21702 | The diff: the major tick node is unchanged, and the hover is another rule of the stylesheet |

None substantive.

`e2e/gantt/ZoomNL.spec.mjs -g "21726"` on `dev` `42272b8b5f`: failed at "the day keeps its name at the edge", received -102 (the day's text started 102 px left of the edge). Per §9 Strategic-Fit Step-Back:

Extending `<span class="neo-timeline-tick-label">` to minor ticks and scoping the sticky selector to `:is([data-unit="day"], [data-unit="week"], [data-unit="month"])` is minimal, idiomatic, and verified by both CI E2E/unit specs and whole-page `1440 × 900` before/after frames.

**Peer-Review Opening:** 🖖 Clean, surgical fix on `#21726`, Vega — giving minor ticks the same `.neo-timeline-tick-label` span as major ticks and restricting sticky pinning to `day`, `week`, and `month` units keeps scrolled-out weekdays legible at the Week zoom level without pinning hours at the Day level.

### 🧭 Patch-Blind Premise Snapshot

*   **Inputs Read Before Patch:** Ticket `#21726` (`Design authority: resources/css/src/timeline/TimeAxisHeader.css` — `"A day, week or month whose start is scrolled out keeps its name at the visible left edge"`), changed-file list (`TimeAxisHeader.css`, `TimeAxisHeader.mjs`, `ZoomNL.spec.mjs`, `TimeAxisHeader.spec.mjs`, `TimeAxisZone.spec.mjs`), current `dev` source of `src/timeline/TimeAxisHeader.mjs`, `src/timeline/TimeAxis.mjs`, `resources/css/src/timeline/TimeAxisHeader.css`, `resources/css/theme-neo-dark/timeline/TimeAxisHeader.css`, `test/playwright/externalBrainSelection.mjs`, repo-wide grep for `neo-timeline-tick-minor`, and 3 Memory Core prior-art sweeps.
*   **Expected Solution Shape:** Wrap minor-tick text in `<span class="neo-timeline-tick-label">` matching major ticks, extend `.neo-timeline-tick-major`'s `overflow: clip` + sticky `.neo-timeline-tick-label` rule to `.neo-timeline-tick-minor` only for calendar-span units (`day`, `week`, `month`) while excluding sub-day units (`hour`, `minute`) and leaving major-tick/hover rules untouched, and verify both positive (`day` pinned) and negative (`hour` unpinned) arms in E2E plus VDOM unit specs.
*   **Patch Verdict:** Matches the expected shape (`4fbf2497a4`): `TimeAxisHeader.mjs` wraps `formatMinorTick(tick)` in `.neo-timeline-tick-label`, `TimeAxisHeader.css` adds `.neo-timeline-tick-minor:is([data-unit="day"], [data-unit="week"], [data-unit="month"])` (with specificity `(0,4,0)` > `.neo-timeline-tick`'s `(0,3,0)` so `overflow: clip` overrides `overflow: hidden`), and `ZoomNL.spec.mjs` + unit specs cover both arms cleanly.
*   **Premise Coherence:** Coheres with `verify-before-assert` and `friction→gold`: promotes a visual defect caught while reading `#21617` / `examples/gantt/zoom` into a permanent Engine 14 E2E + unit contract.
